primaryMetaphor: Smart loading systems - Skills as on-demand folders vs MCP as pre-loaded dashboards
visualContinuity: Loading paradigm evolution from question to comparison to understanding

scenes.name: The Question

keySync.visualEvent: Skills folder icon glows cyan on left side

scenes.visual: Split screen comparison setup forms with dissolving question mark. Left side shows minimalist folder icon (representing Skills), right side shows server icon (representing MCP). Clean cyan and purple color separation. Background is deep dark (#0a0a0f) with subtle grid pattern suggesting technical environment.
scenes.emotion: Curiosity and anticipation for the explanation
scenes.connectsTo: Question mark dissolves into skills folder that becomes focus of next scene

scenes.name: Skills Introduction

keySync.visualEvent: Folder icon transforms from flat to dimensional with cyan glow

scenes.visual: Left side expands to full focus. Sleek cyan folder materializes with gentle hover animation. Design emphasizes minimalism and efficiency. Subtle particle effects suggest contained intelligence. Folder has clean, modern design with soft cyan (#00f5d4) glow. Typography appears showing 'SKILL' label.
scenes.emotion: Understanding and appreciation for elegant simplicity
scenes.buildsFrom: Question setup transforms into focused skills explanation
scenes.connectsTo: Simple folder will open to reveal internal architecture

scenes.name: Skills Architecture

keySync.visualEvent: Body section illuminates with rich detailed content

scenes.visual: Skills folder opens to reveal two distinct architectural sections. Top section glows cyan labeled 'FRONT MATTER' (name + description), bottom larger section initially dim labeled 'BODY' (detailed instructions, scripts, resources). At sync point, body section illuminates with flowing data particles, code snippets, and resource icons. Clean separation shows the two-part structure.
scenes.buildsFrom: Simple folder expands to show sophisticated internal organization
scenes.connectsTo: Architecture diagram will demonstrate selective loading behavior

scenes.name: Lazy Loading Magic

keySync.visualEvent: Cyan pulse emphasizes minimal front matter loading

scenes.visual: Animation demonstrates selective loading efficiency. Front matter section actively glowing cyan with data streams flowing. Body section remains dormant/dimmed until 'invoked'. At sync point, strong cyan pulse highlights the minimalist loading approach. Particle streams show efficient, targeted data flow only when needed. Loading indicator shows minimal resource usage.
scenes.buildsFrom: Static architecture becomes dynamic loading demonstration
scenes.connectsTo: Efficient skills loading contrasts with upcoming MCP approach

scenes.name: MCP Server Introduction

keySync.visualEvent: MCP dashboard materializes with all panels lighting up simultaneously

scenes.visual: Right side activates with purple theme. Server icon expands into comprehensive dashboard with multiple tool panels, API endpoints, and capability modules - all simultaneously active and glowing purple (#7b2cbf). Heavy data streams flow from all directions. Dashboard shows complexity and power with labels like 'TOOLS', 'APIS', 'RESOURCES' all illuminated at startup.
scenes.buildsFrom: Static server icon expands to show full operational capacity
scenes.connectsTo: Fully loaded dashboard will show resource impact

scenes.name: Context Performance Trade-off

keySync.visualEvent: MCP context meter spikes dramatically with warning flash

scenes.visual: Context usage meters appear above both systems. Skills meter shows minimal cyan usage (10-20%), MCP meter shows heavy purple usage approaching red warning zone (80-90%). At sync point, MCP meter spikes with magenta warning flash (#f72585). Performance indicators show Skills maintaining efficiency while MCP consumes significant resources. Visual comparison emphasizes the trade-off between capability and performance.
scenes.emotion: Understanding of performance implications and trade-offs
scenes.buildsFrom: Both systems now analyzed for resource impact
scenes.connectsTo: Performance comparison leads to capability comparison

scenes.name: Capability Comparison

keySync.visualEvent: Skills side highlights behavior guidance with structured template

scenes.visual: Google Drive use case demonstration. MCP side shows raw API capabilities: 'CREATE FILE', 'DELETE FILE', 'UPDATE FILE' with direct API connection visualized. Skills side shows structured document template with best practices overlay, guidelines, and workflow arrows. At sync point, skills template glows cyan highlighting behavioral guidance vs raw capability.
scenes.buildsFrom: Abstract systems demonstrate concrete real-world applications
scenes.connectsTo: Practical examples crystallize into final comparison

scenes.name: Final Wisdom

keySync.visualEvent: Tool icons flow dynamically on MCP side emphasizing raw capabilities

scenes.visual: Side-by-side summary comparison. MCP side labeled 'RAW TOOLS & CAPABILITIES' with flowing tool icons (APIs, databases, services). Skills side labeled 'BEHAVIOR & GUIDANCE' with structured workflow arrows and best practice indicators. At sync point, tool icons flow dynamically on MCP side. Final frame shows clear categorical distinction with both systems having their place in the ecosystem.
scenes.emotion: Clear resolution and wisdom about appropriate usage
scenes.buildsFrom: Concrete examples crystallize into clear categorical understanding
